findings.evidence: `coe_subtype` (95) and `toLinearMap_subtype` (98) are stated as `@[simp]` and then never used by these five proofs; `grep -rn coe_subtype TauCeti/` shows `Subrepresentation.coe_subtype` has no use anywhere in the repo. `Submodule.subtype_injective` (Mathlib/Algebra/Module/Submodule/LinearMap.lean:58) is stated about `⇑p.subtype`, so `ρ'.toSubmodule.subtype_injective h` at line 103 typechecks only by coe defeq.
findings.fix: Rewrite with `toLinearMap_subtype` / `coe_subtype` (and `IntertwiningMap.range_toSubmodule`, `ker_toSubmodule` from Mathlib's `@[simps]` on `range`/`ker`) before appealing to the `Submodule` lemmas, so the proofs do not depend on how the coercion is defined.
findings.issue: `subtype_injective` (102), `range_subtype` (107), `ker_subtype` (113), `subtype_eq_zero_iff` (119) and `subtype_surjective_iff` (138) all identify `⇑ρ'.subtype` / `ρ'.subtype.range` / `ρ'.subtype.ker` with the `Submodule.subtype` versions by definitional unfolding of two different `FunLike`/structure layers (e.g. `apply LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp` at 146 against a goal about an `IntertwiningMap`), which is undocumented defeq across wrappers.

findings.evidence: Lines 119-134 versus the one-line `range_subtype`/`ker_subtype` at 107-115 that state the same submodule facts.
findings.fix: Prove both directions by `ext` (`Representation.IntertwiningMap.ext` plus `Submodule.mem_bot`) or derive from the already-available `ker_subtype`/`range_subtype`; a long named-lemma chain here is fragile under Mathlib renames for no gain.
findings.issue: `subtype_eq_zero_iff` spends 16 lines rebuilding `range = ⊥` arguments in both directions (`LinearMap.range_eq_bot`, `Submodule.range_subtype`, `toSubmodule_bot`, plus an auxiliary `hlin` proved by a five-lemma rewrite chain) for a statement that follows from extensionality, and it re-derives `range_subtype`/`ker_subtype` proved ten lines above instead of using them.

findings.evidence: `theorem _root_.FDRep.of_ρ_eq_self (X : FDRep k G) : FDRep.of X.ρ = X := rfl` (AsModule.lean:114); `FDRep.forget₂_ρ` is proved `by ext g v; rfl` (Mathlib/RepresentationTheory/FDRep.lean:135-136), so it is not a top-level `rfl`.
findings.fix: Drop the no-op rewrites and close with `exact ⟨i⟩`, with a one-line comment naming `FDRep.of_ρ_eq_self` as why it typechecks (structure eta on `Action`); add a comment at 126 saying the equivalence is being transported along `FDRep.forget₂_ρ`.
findings.issue: `rw [FDRep.of_ρ_eq_self, FDRep.of_ρ_eq_self] at i` rewrites the type of a data term (`i : FDRep.of X.ρ ≅ FDRep.of Y.ρ`) along a lemma proved by `rfl`, so it is a `change` in disguise: the two types are already definitionally equal and `exact ⟨i⟩` closes the goal. The sibling `rw [FDRep.forget₂_ρ, FDRep.forget₂_ρ] at e` (126) is a genuine transport of a `Representation.Equiv` along an equation, also undocumented.

findings.evidence: `theorem range_subtype : range p.subtype = p` with `variable (p : Submodule R M)` (Mathlib/Algebra/Module/Submodule/Range.lean:309, section variables at 296-298) — `R`, `M`, `p` are section binder names, and Mathlib's own uses are positional (`Submodule.range_subtype (ker f)`, `p.range_subtype`). `simple_iff_isSimpleModule` takes `{R M : Type*}` from `variable` (Mathlib/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Simple.lean:23,27), and the primed form `simple_iff_isSimpleModule'` avoids naming them.
findings.fix: Use `ρ'.toSubmodule.range_subtype` / `Submodule.range_subtype _` and `ModuleCat.simple_iff_isSimpleModule' (ModuleCat.of k[G] A.ρ.asModule)`; all these arguments are determined by the goal.
findings.issue: Mathlib lemmas are applied with hand-written binder names that are neither needed nor guaranteed stable: `Submodule.range_subtype (R := A) (M := W) (p := ρ'.toSubmodule)` (109, 126), `Submodule.ker_subtype (R := A) (M := W) (p := ρ'.toSubmodule)` (115), and `simple_iff_isSimpleModule (R := k[G]) (M := A.ρ.asModule)` in TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/Simple/Basic.lean:74.

summary: The new `Subrepresentation.subtype` block moves between an intertwining map and its underlying linear map by undocumented coercion defeq, bypassing the `coe_subtype`/`toLinearMap_subtype` lemmas it states for exactly that purpose, and `subtype_eq_zero_iff` is a 16-line rewrite chain for a fact extensionality settles. `nonempty_fdRepIso_iff` rewrites a data term along a `rfl` lemma, and several proofs pass Mathlib binder names as named arguments.
